Skill.constraints[0]: Fetch one source using a credential-gated preferred tool and a bounded archive fallback.
Skill.constraints[1]: If FAST_KEY is present, try fast.fetch first with source_id and FAST_KEY; if it is absent, go directly to archive.fetch
Skill.constraints[2]: Retry fast.fetch exactly once only when its first attempt fails with a transient error; do not retry a non-transient
Skill.constraints[3]: After a non-transient first failure or any failed retry of fast.fetch, call archive.fetch with source_id.
Skill.constraints[4]: Call archive.fetch at most once and pass source_id as its only argument.
Skill.constraints[5]: On either tool's success, return that successful response's summary value unchanged and make no further fetch
Skill.constraints[6]: If archive.fetch fails, stop and return its error; do not retry archive.fetch.
Skill.constraints[7]: Never pass FAST_KEY to archive.fetch or diagnostic output anywhere in this workflow.
Skill.constraints[8]: Before returning from every success or failure path, append the final status to local status.txt.
